subject: PSO compile stall root cause: fixed_frag SPIR-V is 97% dead (528 KB -> 16 KB live); taking mali_graphics_compiler.c translate_specialized
body: Device c6jb/c6k: every slow miss is fixed_vert_lph_spc+fixed_frag_lph_cph (air 560-900 ms, mali 230-650 ms each; all others ~45+25 ms). Its fully-specialized SPIR-V is 528-598 KB (fs= in TEGU_PSO_MISS mali is the SPIR-V size). spirv-opt -O on it gives 16 KB: QuartzCore's state struct is a constant-address-space global initialized from the function constants; the translator (canon/const_loads.rs) folds only POINTER loads from constant globals ('a load of any other type ... is lowered from the global's form'), so every switch on fc_blend_function/fc_texture_function etc. survives as a load from a Private OpVariable with a constant initializer, never stored. Mesa only folds it at bifrost_preprocess_nir (nir_lower_global_vars_to_local), after our lower_generic_resources/fold_fixed_ui_texture_r85 and validations ran on the full body (host profile 2 pipelines: mali 293 ms = fold_r85 91, nir_validate 73, spirv_to_nir 53; air 189 ms). Plan (mine, no other file): translate_specialized runs nir_lower_global_vars_to_local + initializer lowering + a cleanup loop right after inlining (canonical Mesa passes, same that bifrost_preprocess runs later); verify Mali binaries byte-equal on the c6jb corpus. Translator-side fix (extend const_loads to scalar/vector loads; exact: never-written constant global) would cut AIR too but is in the metal2vulkan pin: I will prototype it in a scratch copy and measure only, no pin edit without root handoff. Host replay timing tool: private Mali .so via LD_LIBRARY_PATH, shared build/mesa-build untouched.
